standard.sourcePass: Requires zero unsupported claims, complete selected meanings, local conditions/possibility, no invented geometry/events/causal effects, complete parents and required chronology.
standard.contextIntegrationScale: 1 absent; 2 juxtaposed; 3 shared scene with missing/thin selected contribution; 4 complete distinct selected contributions in the same situation; 5 fully integrated and exceptionally economical. Applicable only when more than one selected meaning must be integrated.

sentenceAudit.text: An extra check can look small beside a familiar task you've set an afternoon aside to finish.
sentenceAudit.reason: Supported possible scene. The indefinite a familiar task is introduced inside can look; its restrictive relative clause specifies the imagined scheduled task from the supplied afternoon-set-aside material. I do not read this as a claim that the reader has in fact booked an afternoon. The sentence is less explicitly conditional than an if opening, but does not on this reading establish a known personal event or promised completion.

sentenceAudit.text: A familiar responsibility can need more effort than usual, and if the original task already fills the afternoon, that extra check still needs some of the same hours.

sentenceAudit.text: If it asks for more than the available hours can hold, what belongs in the task may need a clearer limit.
sentenceAudit.reason: Supported. Conditional capacity mismatch and a possible clearer limit preserve the second selected I1 component; the pronoun continues the possible task scene.

sentenceAudit.text: Moving the task to a later calendar opening with the extra check still included leaves that demand in place; if the original work already fills the afternoon, the extra check could stay outside the task.

This does not say the later opening is too short, that rescheduling cannot improve fit, or that overload necessarily continues. The second clause attaches the full-afternoon condition to an optional scope limit. No new emotional, attention, ease, frequency or behavioral effect is claimed.
